label: single_axis_camera_001
resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Keep a clean margin above her complete crown and keep both eyes clearly readable. Frame literally from the complete crown through the upper torso, with the chin, both shoulders, and the described upper-arm gesture inside the image. The camera is the measured axis: obey its crop boundary, camera position, field of view, subject placement, and negative-space relationship exactly. Apply exactly this camera direction as the sole changing axis: Photograph an adult subject using chest-up framing that keeps both shoulders and the upper arm gesture readable from a clean side camera position that preserves the facial profile and body line. The view uses a classic wide field of view that includes context while keeping facial proportions natural and asymmetric placement with generous negative space and one clear visual counterweight. Show the adult woman in a balanced pose, wearing a plain long-sleeve top under broad neutral diffused lighting on an uncluttered warm-grey studio cyclorama. Treat the named camera boundary, view position, field of view, placement, and negative space as literal. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery.
